dog.description_text:
At 7 months old and 24-ish pound (as of 11/14), Cordless Vacuum is a Terrier/Lab mix (with a little mystery mixed in!) who's already mastered the art of stealing hearts. Her mom is a 35-pound mixed breed, so we expect Cordless Vacuum to stay on the smaller side while growing into the perfect adventure-and-snuggle companion.

If you're looking for an easygoing puppy, Cordless Vacuum may just be your girl. She's the more mellow sibling, happy to follow her canine friends wherever they go before settling in for a cozy nap. While she definitely has those adorable puppy zoomies and loves a good wrestling match with her dog buddies, she's just as content curling up in a dog bed or snuggling next to her favorite people.

Cordless Vacuum absolutely adores other dogs and would thrive in a home with a canine companion to show her the ropes. She loves to cuddle up beside them, play chase in the yard, and learn by following their lead. She's also wonderful with kids and adults alike, although she can be a little shy when meeting new people. Give her a little patience and a few gentle pets, and you'll quickly discover the sweet, affectionate puppy hiding behind those cautious first impressions.

This smart little girl is already crate trained, puppy pad trained, and doing a fantastic job learning that potty time happens outside too. Her foster thinks she'll be a breeze to fully house train since she's already showing great habits and loves sticking to a routine.

Cordless Vacuum is quiet, easy to please, and happy to entertain herself when needed. She rarely barks, rides beautifully in the car, has no resource guarding issues, and is the kind of puppy who rolls with whatever the day brings. Whether she's exploring the backyard, cuddling on the couch, or following her favorite dog around the house, Cordless Vacuum is simply happy to be part of the family.

Sweet, gentle, playful, and wonderfully balanced, Cordless Vacuum is the kind of puppy that fits into almost any home. If you're looking for an affectionate best friend who will grow up by your side, Cordless Vacuum is ready to start her next adventure—with you!

If you would like to adopt this Rockstar, please visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
